events.title: Release Delayed & Playtest Sign-Ups Open Now
events.summary: Hello everyone! It's been a while! The full release of the game is nearing the finish line, and we will soon be moving into the testing phase. At this point, I plan to select at least 20 to 30 players for internal testing. As a solo developer, I want to make sure I polish the full version as much as possible so you can have the best experience at launch.
